description: Beech 18 VT-CNY, formerly owned by the Maharaja of Mayurbhanj, donated to the Orissa government 1958, later Cama Aviation and Coal India, sold as scrap 1996 and restored by the Mayfair hotel group for display in the hotel grounds; information board identifies it as VT-CNY (Dec 2022). Source warbirds.in (2009, updated Jan 2023).
aliases: VT-CNY; C-45; Twin Beech; C45; Beech 18
